title: Compact next fixture writes an obsolete observation ID
symptom: The compact-next output-bound fixture fails at evidence creation before its report assertions run.
trigger: Run TC-cli-0120 after the approved slug observation identity implementation.
expected: Create a new observation automatically and reference the returned ID while preserving every report assertion.
actual: evidence add rejects current-one as an old-style ID on a new write.

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: BUG-0025 covers archived done action wording; this is test fixture construction excluded from the identity change affected_paths.
